```{r global-options, include=FALSE}
# Code chunks are shown but not executed: the analysis needs the input files of the
```

# PWAS

This document merges every source file of the PWAS folder. Genetically predicted
plasma protein levels (European reference weights) and brain protein levels (ROSMAP
reference weights) are tested for association with obstructive sleep apnea and with
the five overnight oximetry traits.

The shell scripts run PWAS.assoc_test.R for every chromosome; the R scripts merge the
per-chromosome output, apply the FDR correction and, for the traits that were analysed
further, convert the pQTL data of the significant proteins into the SMR input format.

## Notes on the merged code

* Each section below holds one source file of this folder, and the file name is given
  both in the section heading and in the first comment line of the chunk.
* Every path that pointed at the analysis tree of the original workstation is rewritten
  to a short relative path below the placeholder root `Path/`; `Path/datasource/` stands
  for the input data, `Path/R-4.3.1/bin/` for the R interpreter and
  `Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/` for the SMR executable. Point them at your own
  installation before running the code.
* The Chinese comments and chunk titles of the original scripts are given in English;
  the date of the original document header is not part of this merged file.
* Shell scripts are kept in their own `bash` chunks.

---

## `PWAS_AHI_code.txt`

```{bash "PWAS_AHI_code.txt", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: PWAS_AHI_code.txt (shell script)
# ===========================================================================
#plasma protein PWAS
CHR=22
until [ $CHR -lt 1 ]
do
Path/R-4.3.1/bin/Rscript.exe Path/PWAS/scripts/PWAS.assoc_test.R \
--sumstats Path/datasource/GWAS_data/AHI_TWAS_format.txt \
--weights Path/datasource/PWAS_weight/PWAS_EA/Plasma_Protein_EA_hg19.pos \
--weights_dir Path/datasource/PWAS_weight/PWAS_EA/Plasma_Protein_weights_EA/ \
--ref_ld_chr Path/PWAS/LDref/EUR/chr \
--force_model enet \
--chr ${CHR} \
--out Path/PWAS/PWAS_by_chr/AHI_chr${CHR}.out
let CHR-=1
done


#brain protein PWAS
CHR=22
until [ $CHR -lt 1 ]
do
Path/R-4.3.1/bin/Rscript.exe Path/PWAS/scripts/PWAS.assoc_test.R \
--sumstats Path/datasource/GWAS_data/AHI_TWAS_format.txt \
--weights Path/datasource/PWAS_weight/ROSMAP/train_weights.pos \
--weights_dir Path/datasource/PWAS_weight/ROSMAP/ \
--ref_ld_chr Path/PWAS/LDref/EUR/chr \
--force_model enet \
--chr ${CHR} \
--out Path/PWAS/ROSMAP_PWAS_by_chr/AHI_chr${CHR}.out
let CHR-=1
done
```

## `PWAS_AHI_Rcode.Rmd`

```{r "PWAS_AHI_Rcode.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: PWAS_AHI_Rcode.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(openxlsx)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(data.table)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Merge plasma PWAS results and export
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
results <- tibble()
for (chr in 1:22) {
    results <- rbind(results, read_tsv(paste0("Path/PWAS/PWAS_by_chr/AHI_chr", chr, ".out")))
    if(chr==6){
        results <- rbind(results, read_tsv(paste0("Path/PWAS/PWAS_by_chr/AHI_chr6.out.MHC")))
    }
}
#FDR correction
results$PWAS.P.FDR<-NA
results_temp<-subset(results,results$PWAS.P!=0)
results<-results[-which(results$ID %in% results_temp$ID),]
results_temp$PWAS.P.FDR<-p.adjust(results_temp$PWAS.P,method = "fdr",n = length(results_temp$PWAS.P))
results<-rbind(results_temp,results)
write.xlsx(results,"Path/PWAS/PlasmaPro_AHI_PWAS.xlsx")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Convert the pQTL data of significant plasma proteins into SMR format
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
pwas_res<-read_xlsx("Path/PWAS/PlasmaPro_AHI_PWAS.xlsx",sheet = "Sheet 1")
#Select the significant PWAS results
pwas_res<-subset(pwas_res,pwas_res$PWAS.P.FDR<0.05)
#Extract the file names of the significant results
pwas_res$file_name<- sapply(pwas_res$FILE,function(x){
        temp <- strsplit(x, split = "//")[[1]][2]
				return(as.character(temp))	
				})
pwas_res$file_name_clean<- sapply(pwas_res$file_name,function(x){
        temp <- strsplit(x, split = ".wgt.")[[1]][1]
				return(as.character(temp))	
				})
#Remove duplicated proteins
pwas_res<-pwas_res[order(pwas_res$PWAS.P,decreasing = FALSE),]
pwas_res<-pwas_res[!duplicated(pwas_res$ID),]
#Extract these significant entries from the file-to-protein mapping table
tab<-fread("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/seqid.txt")
tab<-tab[which(tab$seqid_in_sample %in% pwas_res$file_name_clean),]
tab1<-tab
tab$PathOfEsd<-paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/ARIC/AHI/",tab$entrezgenesymbol,".txt",sep = "")
tab$Orientation<-NA
tab$GeneticDistance<-0
tab<-tab[,c("chromosome_name","uniprot_id","GeneticDistance","transcription_start_site","entrezgenesymbol","Orientation","PathOfEsd")]
colnames(tab)<-c("Chr","ProbeID","GeneticDistance","ProbeBp","Gene","Orientation","PathOfEsd")
write.table(tab,file = file.path("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/Plasma_AHI_flist.txt"),sep = "\t",row.names = FALSE,quote = FALSE)

#Process the pQTL data of the significant proteins
for (i in 1:length(tab1$seqid_in_sample)) {
  dat<-fread(paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/EA/",tab1[i,"seqid_in_sample"],".PHENO1.glm.linear",sep = ""))

  dat$P<-as.double(dat$P)
  
  #Select the effect allele
  dat$A2<-""
  for (j in 1:nrow(dat)) {
    if(dat[j,"A1"]==dat[j,"ALT"])
      dat[j,"A2"]<-dat[j,"REF"]
    else
      dat[j,"A2"]<-dat[j,"ALT"]
  }
  dat<-dat[,c("#CHROM","ID","POS","A1","A2","A1_FREQ","BETA","SE","P")]
  colnames(dat)<-c("Chr","SNP","Bp","A1","A2","Freq","Beta","se","p")
  #Lift over to hg19
  dat$Chrom<-paste("chr",dat$Chr,sep = "")
  dt_granges<-GenomicRanges::makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
    dat,
    keep.extra.columns=TRUE,ignore.strand=TRUE,seqinfo=NULL,
    seqnames.field="Chrom",start.field = "Bp",end.field = "Bp",
    starts.in.df.are.0based = FALSE
  )
  ref_chain<-rtracklayer::import.chain(
    file.path("Path/hg38ToHg19.over.chain")
  )
  dat_hg19<-as.data.frame(
    rtracklayer::liftOver(dt_granges,ref_chain)
  )
  dat_hg19<-subset(
    dat_hg19,
    select = -c(group,group_name,end,width,strand)
  )
  dat_hg19<-dplyr::rename(
    dat_hg19,
    Chrom=seqnames,Pos=start
  )
  dat_hg19<-dat_hg19[,c("Chr","SNP","Pos","A1","A2","Freq","Beta","se","p")]
  colnames(dat_hg19)<-c("Chr","SNP","Bp","A1","A2","Freq","Beta","se","p")
  write.table(dat_hg19,
              file = file.path(paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/ARIC/AHI/",tab1[i,"entrezgenesymbol"],".txt",sep = "")),sep = "\t",row.names = FALSE,quote = FALSE)
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Merge brain PWAS results and export
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
results <- tibble()
for (chr in 1:22) {
    results <- rbind(results, read_tsv(paste0("Path/PWAS/ROSMAP_PWAS_by_chr/AHI_chr", chr, ".out")))
    if(chr==6){
        results <- rbind(results, read_tsv(paste0("Path/PWAS/ROSMAP_PWAS_by_chr/AHI_chr6.out.MHC")))
    }
}
results$ID_pro<- substring(results$ID,17,)
#FDR correction
results$PWAS.P.FDR<-NA
results_temp<-subset(results,results$PWAS.P!=0)
results<-results[-which(results$ID %in% results_temp$ID),]
results_temp$PWAS.P.FDR<-p.adjust(results_temp$PWAS.P,method = "fdr",n = length(results_temp$PWAS.P))
results<-rbind(results_temp,results)
write.xlsx(results,"Path/PWAS/BrainPro_AHI_PWAS.xlsx")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Convert the pQTL data of significant brain proteins into SMR format
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
pwas_res<-read_xlsx("Path/PWAS/BrainPro_AHI_PWAS.xlsx",sheet = "Sheet 1")
#Select the significant PWAS results
pwas_res<-subset(pwas_res,pwas_res$PWAS.P.FDR<0.05)
sig_pwas_file<-pwas_res$ID
#Remove duplicated proteins
pwas_res<-pwas_res[order(pwas_res$PWAS.P,decreasing = FALSE),]
pwas_res<-pwas_res[!duplicated(pwas_res$ID),]
#Extract these significant entries from the file-to-protein mapping table
tab<-fread("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/ROSMAP/ROSMAP.for_smr.pQTL v2.txt")
tab<-tab[which(tab$Protein_GeneSymbol %in% sig_pwas_file),]
tab1<-tab
tab<-tab[,c("Protein_Chr","Protein_UniProt","Protein_BP_Start","Protein_GeneSymbol")]
tab<-tab[!duplicated(tab$Protein_UniProt),]
tab$PathOfEsd<-paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/ROSMAP/AHI/",tab$Protein_GeneSymbol,".txt",sep = "")
tab$Orientation<-NA
tab$GeneticDistance<-0
tab<-tab[,c("Protein_Chr","Protein_UniProt","GeneticDistance","Protein_BP_Start","Protein_GeneSymbol","Orientation","PathOfEsd")]
colnames(tab)<-c("Chr","ProbeID","GeneticDistance","ProbeBp","Gene","Orientation","PathOfEsd")
write.table(tab,file = file.path("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/Brain_AHI_flist.txt"),sep = "\t",row.names = FALSE,quote = FALSE)

#Process the pQTL data of the significant proteins
sig_pro<-unique(tab1$Protein_GeneSymbol)
for (i in 1:length(sig_pro)) {
  dat<-subset(tab1,tab1$Protein_GeneSymbol==sig_pro[i])
  
  dat$Freq<-NA
  
  dat<-dat[,c("Chr","SNP","BP","A1","A2","Freq","Beta","SE","P")]
  colnames(dat)<-c("Chr","SNP","Bp","A1","A2","Freq","Beta","se","p")
  
  write.table(dat,
              file = file.path(paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/ROSMAP/AHI/",sig_pro[i],".txt",sep = "")),sep = "\t",row.names = FALSE,quote = FALSE)
}
```

## `PWAS_SleepApnea_Rcode.Rmd`

```{r "PWAS_SleepApnea_Rcode.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: PWAS_SleepApnea_Rcode.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(openxlsx)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(data.table)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Merge plasma PWAS results and export
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
results <- tibble()
for (chr in 1:22) {
    results <- rbind(results, read_tsv(paste0("Path/PWAS/PWAS_by_chr/SleepApnea_chr", chr, ".out")))
    if(chr==6){
        results <- rbind(results, read_tsv(paste0("Path/PWAS/PWAS_by_chr/SleepApnea_chr6.out.MHC")))
    }
}
#FDR correction
results$PWAS.P.FDR<-NA
results_temp<-subset(results,results$PWAS.P!=0)
results<-results[-which(results$ID %in% results_temp$ID),]
results_temp$PWAS.P.FDR<-p.adjust(results_temp$PWAS.P,method = "fdr",n = length(results_temp$PWAS.P))
results<-rbind(results_temp,results)
write.xlsx(results,"Path/PWAS/PlasmaPro_SleepApnea_PWAS.xlsx")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Convert the pQTL data of significant plasma proteins into SMR format
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
pwas_res<-read_xlsx("Path/PWAS/PlasmaPro_SleepApnea_PWAS.xlsx",sheet = "Sheet 1")
#Select the significant PWAS results
pwas_res<-subset(pwas_res,pwas_res$PWAS.P.FDR<0.05)
#Extract the file names of the significant results
pwas_res$file_name<- sapply(pwas_res$FILE,function(x){
        temp <- strsplit(x, split = "//")[[1]][2]
				return(as.character(temp))	
				})
pwas_res$file_name_clean<- sapply(pwas_res$file_name,function(x){
        temp <- strsplit(x, split = ".wgt.")[[1]][1]
				return(as.character(temp))	
				})
#Remove duplicated proteins
pwas_res<-pwas_res[order(pwas_res$PWAS.P.FDR,decreasing = FALSE),]
pwas_res<-pwas_res[!duplicated(pwas_res$ID),]
#Extract these significant entries from the file-to-protein mapping table
tab<-fread("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/seqid.txt")
tab<-tab[which(tab$seqid_in_sample %in% pwas_res$file_name_clean),]
tab1<-tab
tab$PathOfEsd<-paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/ARIC/SleepApnea/",tab$entrezgenesymbol,".txt",sep = "")
tab$Orientation<-NA
tab$GeneticDistance<-0
tab<-tab[,c("chromosome_name","uniprot_id","GeneticDistance","transcription_start_site","entrezgenesymbol","Orientation","PathOfEsd")]
colnames(tab)<-c("Chr","ProbeID","GeneticDistance","ProbeBp","Gene","Orientation","PathOfEsd")
write.table(tab,file = file.path("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/Plasma_SleepApnea_flist.txt"),sep = "\t",row.names = FALSE,quote = FALSE)

#Process the pQTL data of the significant proteins
for (i in 1:length(tab1$seqid_in_sample)) {
  dat<-fread(paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/EA/",tab1[i,"seqid_in_sample"],".PHENO1.glm.linear",sep = ""))
  
  dat$P<-as.double(dat$P)
  
  #Select the effect allele
  dat$A2<-""
  for (j in 1:nrow(dat)) {
    if(dat[j,"A1"]==dat[j,"ALT"])
      dat[j,"A2"]<-dat[j,"REF"]
    else
      dat[j,"A2"]<-dat[j,"ALT"]
  }
  dat<-dat[,c("#CHROM","ID","POS","A1","A2","A1_FREQ","BETA","SE","P")]
  colnames(dat)<-c("Chr","SNP","Bp","A1","A2","Freq","Beta","se","p")
  #Lift over to hg19
  dat$Chrom<-paste("chr",dat$Chr,sep = "")
  dt_granges<-GenomicRanges::makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
    dat,
    keep.extra.columns=TRUE,ignore.strand=TRUE,seqinfo=NULL,
    seqnames.field="Chrom",start.field = "Bp",end.field = "Bp",
    starts.in.df.are.0based = FALSE
  )
  ref_chain<-rtracklayer::import.chain(
    file.path("Path/hg38ToHg19.over.chain")
  )
  dat_hg19<-as.data.frame(
    rtracklayer::liftOver(dt_granges,ref_chain)
  )
  dat_hg19<-subset(
    dat_hg19,
    select = -c(group,group_name,end,width,strand)
  )
  dat_hg19<-dplyr::rename(
    dat_hg19,
    Chrom=seqnames,Pos=start
  )
  dat_hg19<-dat_hg19[,c("Chr","SNP","Pos","A1","A2","Freq","Beta","se","p")]
  colnames(dat_hg19)<-c("Chr","SNP","Bp","A1","A2","Freq","Beta","se","p")
  write.table(dat_hg19,
              file = file.path(paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/ARIC/SleepApnea/",tab1[i,"entrezgenesymbol"],".txt",sep = "")),sep = "\t",row.names = FALSE,quote = FALSE)
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Merge brain PWAS results and export
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
results <- tibble()
for (chr in 1:22) {
    results <- rbind(results, read_tsv(paste0("Path/PWAS/ROSMAP_PWAS_by_chr/SleepApnea_chr", chr, ".out")))
    if(chr==6){
        results <- rbind(results,read_tsv(paste0("Path/PWAS/ROSMAP_PWAS_by_chr/SleepApnea_chr6.out.MHC")))
    }
}
results$ID_pro<- substring(results$ID,17,)
#FDR correction
results$PWAS.P.FDR<-NA
results_temp<-subset(results,results$PWAS.P!=0)
results<-results[-which(results$ID %in% results_temp$ID),]
results_temp$PWAS.P.FDR<-p.adjust(results_temp$PWAS.P,method = "fdr",n = length(results_temp$PWAS.P))
results<-rbind(results_temp,results)
write.xlsx(results,"Path/PWAS/BrainPro_SleepApnea_PWAS.xlsx")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Convert the pQTL data of significant brain proteins into SMR format
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
pwas_res<-read_xlsx("Path/PWAS/BrainPro_SleepApnea_PWAS.xlsx",sheet = "Sheet 1")
#Select the significant PWAS results
pwas_res<-subset(pwas_res,pwas_res$PWAS.P.FDR<0.05)
sig_pwas_file<-pwas_res$ID
#Remove duplicated proteins
pwas_res<-pwas_res[order(pwas_res$PWAS.P,decreasing = FALSE),]
pwas_res<-pwas_res[!duplicated(pwas_res$ID),]
#Extract these significant entries from the file-to-protein mapping table
tab<-fread("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/ROSMAP/ROSMAP.for_smr.pQTL v2.txt")
tab<-tab[which(tab$Protein_GeneSymbol %in% sig_pwas_file),]
tab1<-tab
tab<-tab[,c("Protein_Chr","Protein_UniProt","Protein_BP_Start","Protein_GeneSymbol")]
tab<-tab[!duplicated(tab$Protein_UniProt),]
tab$PathOfEsd<-paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/ROSMAP/SleepApnea/",tab$Protein_GeneSymbol,".txt",sep = "")
tab$Orientation<-NA
tab$GeneticDistance<-0
tab<-tab[,c("Protein_Chr","Protein_UniProt","GeneticDistance","Protein_BP_Start","Protein_GeneSymbol","Orientation","PathOfEsd")]
colnames(tab)<-c("Chr","ProbeID","GeneticDistance","ProbeBp","Gene","Orientation","PathOfEsd")
write.table(tab,file = file.path("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/Brain_SleepApnea_flist.txt"),sep = "\t",row.names = FALSE,quote = FALSE)

#Process the pQTL data of the significant proteins
sig_pro<-unique(tab1$Protein_GeneSymbol)
for (i in 1:length(sig_pro)) {
  dat<-subset(tab1,tab1$Protein_GeneSymbol==sig_pro[i])
  
  dat$Freq<-NA
  
  dat<-dat[,c("Chr","SNP","BP","A1","A2","Freq","Beta","SE","P")]
  colnames(dat)<-c("Chr","SNP","Bp","A1","A2","Freq","Beta","se","p")
  
  write.table(dat,
              file = file.path(paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/ROSMAP/SleepApnea/",sig_pro[i],".txt",sep = "")),sep = "\t",row.names = FALSE,quote = FALSE)
}
```
